verses.gurmukhi: ੯ : ਨਿੱਕੇ ਹੋਣ ਪੁਰ ਲੋਕ ਪ੍ਰਸਿੱਧ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ
verses.translit_en: 9 : ni'ke hon pur lok prasi'dh prasa(n)g

en.bdb: Many a story of becoming humble

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜ ਪਾਸਿ ਬਿਆਸੁ ਜਾਇ ਹੋਇ ਭੁਣਹਣਾ ਕੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: sooraj paas biaas jai hoi bhunahanaa ka(n)n samaanaa|

en.bdb: Rishi Vyas went to sun and becoming a small insect entered into his ear i.e. most humbly he remained with him and got educated by sun).

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੜੑਹਿ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਲਮੀਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: paR(h)h vidhiaa ghar aaiaa gurmukh baalameek man bhaanaa|

en.bdb: Valmiki also only becoming guru- oriented attained knowledge and then he returned home.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਬਿਆਸ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: aadh biaas vakhaaneeaai kath kath saasatr vedh puraanaa|

en.bdb: The exponent of many stories of the Vedas, Shastras and the Puranas Valmili is known as the primal poet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਦਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਗਵਤੁ ਪੜੑਹਿ ਪਤੀਆਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: naaradh mun upadhesiaa bhagat bhaagavat paR(h)h pateeaanaa|

en.bdb: Sage Narad  preached to him and only after reading the Blia-gavat of devotion he could attain peace.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਉਦਹ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਸੋਧਿਕੈ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ਸੁਖਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: chaudheh vidhiaa sodhikai paraupakaar achaar sukhaanaa|

en.bdb: He researched  the fourteen skills but ultimately he got happiness due to his benevolent conduct.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: paraupakaaree saadhasa(n)g patit udhaaran biradh vakhaanaa|

en.bdb: Association with such humble sadhus is altruistic and makes one habitual liberates of the fallen ones.
Gurmukhs attain pleasure fruits in it and get dignified acceptance in the court of the Lord.
